record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The eight units in appliesTo declare HEADBUTT in this production reference: Darumaka, Galarian Darumaka, Wooloo (1 star), Darmanitan, Galarian Darmanitan, Dubwool (2 stars), Eiscue and Eiscue Noice (3 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index) and, for Eiscue, the passive the strategy tests by value. The passives DARMANITAN, GALARIAN_DARMANITAN and FUR_COAT are not covered here.
record.summary: SPECIAL damage to the target, base 20 / 40 / 80 / 160 (fallback 160). An Ice Face Eiscue first adds its current shield and removes it with addShield(-shield, self, 0, false), depleting it and running OnShieldDepleted (transformToNoice); then, if the target has shield > 0, the whole raw sum doubles (3 stars, shield 50 vs a shielded target requests 260). The damage argument is a snapshot, unchanged by the form change. Flinch 5000 ms follows AFTER the damage, so a new flinch cannot split this hit.

targeting.who: the cast target chosen before the cast (the strategy never changes it); requiresTarget is true so the caster must have a target
targeting.note: The strategy does not move the caster or pick a different enemy. The doubling checks the target's shield at cast time, after any Ice Face shield has been added to the damage.

effects.scaling: AP: x(1 + AP/100) (apBoost true); a cast crit multiplies by critPower (needs ABILITY_CRIT). Raw modifiers before that, in order: for a caster with passive EISCUE_ICE_FACE, + its current shield and the shield is removed (addShield(-shield, self, 0, false): a Big Eater Belt turns -50 into -63 and -100 into -125, which only overshoots; shield ends 0, the overshoot is not extra damage); then x2 if the target has shield > 0, covering the added shield. Executed: 130 without a target shield, 260 with one; an Eiscue Noice caster has no conversion (160, shield 50 kept); an Ice Face caster with shield 0 requests addShield(-0) (no hook).
effects.resolution: then the target's SPE_DEF division and later modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (damage 0, executed). A flinch already active at the hit splits the target's shield (shield 100 -> 20, HP -80); the flinch applied by this cast comes after and cannot split this hit (shield 100 -> 0, HP -60). The returned takenDamage is not read.

statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit (no apBoost argument); applied after the damage call
statusEffects.guards: Refused by Rune Protect (executed); the duration passes applyStatusDurationReductions; a new flinch replaces the remaining time only if longer (9000 kept). Applied after the damage whatever its result (a Protected target is still flinched).
statusEffects.combatEffect: read in pokemon-state: while flinched, a shielded unit takes only half of reduced damage on the shield and the other half passes to HP. Other uses of flinch (status.ts hasNegativeStatus list, transferNegativeStatus, pokemon-entity flinch chance at line 1048) were located but not analysed.

shields.description: Removes ALL of the caster's current shield (addShield(-shield, caster, 0, false)) and adds it to the damage; a shield of 0 adds nothing and changes nothing.
shields.effect: when the removal leaves shield <= 0 with a negative change, the OnShieldDepletedEffect of EISCUE_ICE_FACE runs and the unit becomes Eiscue Noice (name, index, passive changed, shield 0). Eiscue Noice returns to Ice Face only through its own passive (start of a fight under SNOW) or other freeze-related code that was not read.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star column (160) is declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes (Darumaka / Wooloo 1, Darmanitan / Dubwool 2, Eiscue 3). Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy. The cast needs a target (requiresTarget true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state in the strategy. Eiscue (Ice Face) changes form into Noice after a cast that consumes shield; the next casts as Noice use the plain star table with no shield conversion until the form is restored by other code. Two flinches on the same target extend only if the new duration is longer.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 20 / 40 / 80 / 160, x2 against a shielded target, plus the caster's current shield for an Ice Face Eiscue (summed before the doubling); flinch 5000 ms. The damage argument is the snapshot sum; the dealt amount is that x (1 + AP/100) [x crit] after SPE_DEF and shields. The shield-removal overshoot (Belt) is not extra damage.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleSpecialDamage's later modifiers (SPE_DEF division, shields, items, damage reduction, resurrection, field multipliers) - not re-read here
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were located
What else consumes flinch (hasNegativeStatus lists, the 30% flinch chance at pokemon-entity.ts:1048, curse vulnerability)
unresolved: Passives DARMANITAN, GALARIAN_DARMANITAN (zen-mode transformations) and FUR_COAT are not investigated; whether they change the cast or the unit's stats during a fight is unknown
Only the OnShieldDepleted -> transformToNoice hook of the Ice Face passive was traced; other Eiscue passive hooks (including return to Ice Face) were not

The Big Eater Belt applies to the negative addShield value because the caster is the same unit (executed: -50 becomes -63, -100 becomes -125); only the shield clamp and the OnShieldDepleted hook follow
The target-shield check happens once, before the damage call, and the flinch of this cast comes after (executed: a new flinch cannot split this hit; an already active flinch does)
Whether Eiscue Noice or the other listed units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (addShield + the Big Eater Belt helper, transformToNoice, triggerFlinch, handleSpecialDamage) and the real HeadbuttStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_E2); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in units): the damage sums and doubling, the Ice Face shield removal and its hook, the Belt values, the snapshot surviving the form change, the Noice and no-shield cases, and the flinch order against an active or new flinch.
